title: Can You Survive Day Three of the Apocalypse?
logline: Reaching Clearwater Dam at dawn on Day Three expecting a safe fortress, you and Maya uncover a breached gate overrun with forty infected and two armed scavengers laying a road-crate ambush from the high catwalk—forcing a silent crawl beneath the dam, a perilous dockside escape, and a dash across deep mountain water.
